Hi Lauren / Tessa,

Tessa / Logan — quick take:

- Catering: go boxed lunches (keeps demo flow tight, shorter queueing). Budget-wise OK?
- Giveaway flow: hand out at counter. We want to control distribution and capture leads. Plan for a staffed grab-and-scan station.
- Dock: prefer the 08:00–11:00 morning window for crate arrival. That gives us time to set before attendee doors.

Marissa — can you confirm we have staffing to support a staffed giveaway station from 10:30–14:00 each day? If not, we’ll need to compress to 11:30–13:00 when demos are slower.

I updated the swag list (swag_line_item_sheet.xlsx) and attached. Also looping WestHall to confirm dock slot.
